description:
Everything that matters about one company in one call: the explained insider signal (score, cluster and
C-suite buying, unusual vs history) PLUS the next earnings date and countdown (and last earnings), the stock's
volatility regime (calm / normal / elevated / extreme vs its own past year), trend vs 50/200-day averages,
drawdown from the 52-week high, recent returns, Wall Street analyst consensus and its 3-month trend, and the
market backdrop (regime + next Fed meeting odds). Ends with 'what stands out' facts. Use for 'analyze X',
'should I look closer at X?', 'anything notable about X before earnings?'. Also includes the company's
financials (valuation, growth, profit) and dilution summary. Includes 'analysis': a written
CapitalSnitch Take (headline, story, bull case, bear case, what to watch) grounded in the data — present it to the
user, and say it is automated context, not investment advice.
